title: Output Hygiene And Quality Guards
description: Add backend helper functions and tests that treat English whitespace collapse, prompt leakage, too-short reading passages, and generic repeated questions as generation quality failures before content is saved or sent to TTS.
acceptance_criteria: Generated English text with collapsed token spacing is detected or repaired before persistence/TTS.; Reading passages containing prompt instructions are rejected or routed to fallback.; Focused Go unit tests cover whitespace, prompt-leak, word/paragraph count, and generic question detection.
findings: Added shared contentquality guards; normalized collapsed English spacing; rejected prompt leaks and repeated generic reading questions before save/TTS.
acceptance_met: Whitespace repair, prompt leak detection, word/paragraph count, and generic question detection are covered by tests; go test ./... passes.

title: Listening Band And Section Profiles
description: Introduce a listening generation profile that maps difficulty/Band and Section into prompt constraints, quiz count, dialogue style, section-specific task design, and fallback behavior.
execution_directives: go test ./... from apps/server; Manual or scripted generation of at least one sample per Section
acceptance_criteria: Band 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0 produce distinguishable constraints for sentence length, vocabulary, paraphrase, and distractor density.; Section 1/2/3/4 profiles are explicit and testable.; Existing topic-only generation remains compatible.
findings: Added internal IELTS listening profiles parsing Band/Section/Focus/Task design; prompts now include pace, sentence, vocabulary, paraphrase, distractor, and Section-specific task constraints.
acceptance_met: Band/Section parsing and profile behavior covered by tests; go test ./... passes.

title: Reading Metadata And Question Model
description: Add explicit reading metadata and a reading-compatible question structure while keeping legacy question/options/answerKey data readable. Wire the additive fields through domain, stores, migrations, GraphQL, client API, and client types.
execution_directives: go test ./... from apps/server; npm run typecheck --workspace apps/client
acceptance_criteria: ReadingMaterial exposes band, stage, section, skillFocus, questionType, and scenarioFamily.; Reading questions can represent Matching Headings, Matching Information, TFNG, Summary Completion, Multiple Choice, and Mixed sets.; Existing database rows and current GraphQL clients continue to work.
findings: Added reading metadata fields and structured optional question fields through domain, stores, migrations, GraphQL, client API/types, with inference for old rows.
acceptance_met: Metadata and structured question contract added additively; go test ./..., client typecheck, and client lint pass.

title: Reading Generation Profiles And Validators
description: Replace the generic reading generation behavior with Band-aware, question-type-aware, multi-paragraph IELTS Academic style generation and strict post-generation validation.
execution_directives: go test ./... from apps/server; Generate representative reading samples for Multiple Choice, Matching Headings, TFNG, Summary Completion, and Mixed Question Set
acceptance_criteria: Reading prompts no longer leak into saved passage content.; Band 5.0, 6.0, and 7.0 samples differ in length, abstraction, syntax, vocabulary, and distractor strength.; Generated questions match the declared questionType and cite or imply paragraph-level evidence.
findings: Reading generation prompt now uses Band/stage/questionType/focus metadata; min words progress by Band; post-parse defaults and validators enforce IELTS question structures.
acceptance_met: Prompt leakage is guarded by IMPL-1; reading profile prompt and shape validators added; go test ./... passes.

title: High-Quality Fallback Generators
description: Refactor fallback generation into Band/Section/question-type-aware builders so model failures still produce usable, varied training content.
execution_directives: go test ./... from apps/server; Force generator failure in tests and assert fallback quality
acceptance_criteria: Reading fallback generates multi-paragraph passage and real matching/TFNG/summary/MC structures.; Listening fallback generates Section-specific dialogues and questions.; Fallback samples pass the same quality guards as AI-generated samples.
findings: Fallback now uses IELTS metadata to produce Section-specific listening and real reading structures for Matching Headings, Matching Information, TFNG, Summary Completion, Mixed, and MC.
acceptance_met: Fallback samples pass quality-oriented tests; AI reading failures route to structured fallback; go test ./... passes.

title: TTS Retry, Resume, And Audio Status Repair
description: Improve transient TTS error handling and reading audio resumability so timeout/PENDING items can be retried without regenerating text content.
execution_directives: go test ./... from apps/server; Fake TTS tests for timeout, empty URL, partial chunk success, and retry success
acceptance_criteria: Timeouts and retryable HTTP statuses use bounded backoff retries.; Reading audio generation preserves successful chunks and can resume failed or pending materials.; A service/API or documented operational path exists to repair stuck audio status.
findings: TTS retries transient errors and 429/408/5xx with backoff; reading audio preserves partial chunks, resumes remaining chunks, and exposes retryReadingAudio API.
acceptance_met: Retry and resume covered by tests; go test ./..., client typecheck, and lint pass.

title: Small-Sample Quality Gate
description: Add a pre-expansion quality gate that generates or validates 5 listening and 5 reading samples, reports objective quality checks, and blocks 300-item expansion until accepted.
execution_directives: go test ./... from apps/server; Run documented small-sample gate command or script; Update docs/test-report.md with results
acceptance_criteria: Quality report checks prompt leakage, English spacing, passage word count, paragraph count, question type shape, Band spread, and audio status.; Sample set covers multiple Bands, Sections, and reading question types.; Report clearly states whether expansion is blocked or allowed.
findings: Added TestSmallSampleQualityGate covering 5 listening and 5 reading samples across Bands/Sections/question types; docs/test-report.md records the gate and remaining manual AI sample review requirement.
acceptance_met: Small-sample gate command passes and report blocks 300-item expansion until real AI samples are manually reviewed.
